<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
triu(x, k=0) -> 'core.SymbolicTensor'
```

Part of [`evoxc.ops`](/api/evoxc/ops/)

Upper triangle of the last two dims (numpy `triu` semantics); batch
dims are preserved as-is.

## Parameters

- `x` — `SymbolicTensor` of rank >= 2.

- `k` — int diagonal offset (0 = main diagonal).

## Returns

- `'core.SymbolicTensor'` — `SymbolicTensor` with entries below the `k`-th diagonal zeroed; shape and dtype preserved.
